body: The jar is dusted with the same yellow grains as the torn sack. Its label names a test plot, but the string tying them together is wet with roadside mud. A strip of cloth keeps the pair together.
title: A jar beyond the rows after the shift

body: A clean bottle and a cloudy bucket share a chalk mark. The bucket was filled far from the rows after the sprayer passed. The corner still bears a hurried thumbprint.
title: Water kept for comparison after the shift

body: One cuff of the gloves is caked with field dust; the other is stained with kitchen soap. The empty sprayer tied to them still smells of orchard rows. One edge was kept dry beneath a coat.
title: The gloves used twice after the shift

body: The feed sack has an oily streak beneath its fold. A rinse pail carries the same mark above the waterline. A short tally was added after the bundle was tied.
title: Feed beside a rinse pail after the shift

body: Tape seals a slit in the seed sack, but the pale dust beneath it is caught on the outside. A child’s height is marked on the tape. The string has been retied since morning.
title: The unopened seed allotment after the shift

body: The jar’s paper label names a trial row. A thumbprint in its residue falls on a different roadside mark on the map. The date is on the wrapper, not on the object.
title: A sample without its field after the shift

body: The loaf was wrapped in a clean cloth. Yellow spray powder lies between the cloth and the crust, though the knot was never opened. A strip of cloth keeps the pair together.
title: Bread under field dust after the shift

body: The sponge is green at the center and the soap is worn only on one edge, both dusted with fine field grains. They were wrapped in a bag beside a small cup stained with spray residue. The corner still bears a hurried thumbprint.
title: The wash that failed after the shift

body: The card asks for supper to be kept warm. A ring from the sprayer crosses the writing before the ink has dried. One edge was kept dry beneath a coat.
title: A warning carried home after the shift

body: Fine grains cling to the rim of a drinking glass. The fertilizer sack beside it was sealed with household thread. A short tally was added after the bundle was tied.
title: Fertilizer and a dry cup after the shift
